hypotheses.H1: Robust plane residuals, weak-direction projection and odometry regularization reduce corruption/degeneracy-driven drift; cannot create missing absolute constraints
hypotheses.H2: A real 4m depth camera supplies additional height geometry only if distinctive surfaces are visible and mapped; parallel walls alone remain ambiguous
hypotheses.H3: Bounded multi-candidate search with uniqueness and consecutive odometry-consistent confirmation can correct an offset initial belief where local fitting cannot

parameters.search_trigger: unconfirmed startup, rank<3, median residual>0.08m, or inlier fraction<0.6

arms: 2D lidar + depth camera, no 3D lidar in B URDF

depth.noise: ideal rendered depth, no hardware noise model

pose_scope: x/y/yaw; z fixed to median mapping-A body height reconstructed with actual URDF extrinsics; roll/pitch=0; native GICP still unconstrained
mapping: Separate measured A per scene, supplied mapping poses, raw lidar point map and independent depth point map; static A reused for persistent-change B; frozen maps
truth_in_B: independent scoring only; never an estimator input
sampling: all recorded published outputs; custom variants share frame IDs and sensor/odom bytes; native anchors consume the same live source independently
metrics: XY RMSE for 2D, XYZ RMSE for 3D; no spatial alignment; truth delta<=0.05s; first registered estimates, no unpublished initial belief or missing-output zero fill
recovery_evaluation: after actual observation-restoration stamp: XY<0.1m and |yaw|<5deg continuously >=5s with >=8 updates; retained XYZ/rotation separately
limitations: Exploratory single run, no stable ranking
Native-vs-prototype differences include motion prior, optimizer and map representation; no isolated sensor attribution
Bounded +/-2m, +/-30deg search, not arbitrary global kidnapping
No online map update or full 3D SLAM
Height control changes the world and is explicitly separate from original corridor
correction: Align internal XYZ map coordinates to the body reference calibrated from mapping A; publish world Z using that same fixed prior. All H1/H2/H3 settings remain unchanged. Localization B truth is never used for calibration.

static.source: median body height reconstructed from mapping-A supplied sensor poses and actual URDF extrinsics
